seo.ogDescription: High-energy pickleball tournament benefiting Central High School Tennis. June 19-21, 2025 at Pickler Universe, Carrollton TX.

about.description: A non-profit tournament company where community interaction and inclusion comes before charity earnings. A Friday coed moneyball followed by 2 days of mens, womens, and mixed doubles brings a reason to sign-up and play. 100% of profits go directly to the Central High School Tennis Program to support costs associated with equipment, uniforms, travel, and facilities.

inclusive.title: INCLUSIVE
inclusive.description: From amateur (2.0-2.5) divisions to 4.5+ there is an opportunity for everyone to explore camaraderie in an empowering way.

competitive.title: COMPETITIVE
competitive.description: Win cash from the moneyball, medals from regular divisions, and raffle SWAG from just simply registering.

cause.title: FOR A CAUSE
cause.description: Every contribution makes a difference for the future generations of Tennis and Pickleball.

event.divisionFee: $25 division fee for doubles OR $50 for moneyball
event.format: Pool play (first to 15, win by 2) → single elimination bracket (everyone in pool advances) → medal matches (2/3 to 11, win by 2)
whatYouGet: Guarantee of no pool bigger than 6 people

breakdown.description: Waco, Corpus Christi, Abilene - tourney costs, travel

founder.name: Petr Sakharov
founder.myReason:
$700 Million in debt; that's the origin of Picklebolt.

Facing severe budget cuts after COVID, Keller ISD cut funding to athletic programs across the district. One stood too close to heart: Tennis. As varsity captain, I understood playing with three-year-old tennis balls and limited personalized coaching set my team back as we pushed towards 6A regionals.
founder.whoAmI: I'm a 17 year old senior at Central High School that saw a vision to change something I've seen develop for nearly a decade. Being a part of the tennis program through summer drills and my sibling, I've been alongside Central Tennis since 4th grade. Now, as a 4th year varsity player and 2nd year captain, I took it into my hands to revolutionize our program and make a change that was once only a dream.
